integrity.blowup_basis: Euler characteristic changes under a smooth codimension-c blow-up by (c-1) times the Euler characteristic of the center.
integrity.center_basis: The rank-r center records an u-plane, a kernel of dimension u-r, an r-plane image, and a square rank-r complete collineation on quotient-to-image data.
integrity.closed_form_basis: After inserting the inductive square formula, both the square and rectangular recurrences reduce to explicit telescoping factorial identities.
integrity.construction_basis: Thaddeus defines rank-u complete collineations and states Vainsencher's recursive blow-up construction from the projective Hom bundle.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/9808114 lists version 1 on 1998-08-27.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14M15 as Primary.

scientific_limitations: The theorem gives ordinary Euler characteristic, not the full Poincare polynomial or cohomology ring.
It concerns the standard Vainsencher--Thaddeus compactification, not arbitrary compactifications of the same open rank locus.
An older unindexed computation may exist because the resulting recurrence telescopes elementarily.
title: Euler characteristic of rank-u complete collineations
